scope: Custom model-controlled Town03 diagnostic with a dense GlobalRoutePlanner route, blocked-vehicle termination, inference every 10 frames, and no traffic. This is not an official Bench2Drive leaderboard score.
latency_definition: Steady state excludes the first model inference. Service end-to-end includes request NPZ loading, image preprocessing, recurrent-state update, output transfer, and JSON response.
trajectory_protocol: Both the deployment-PyTorch and TensorRT CARLA services consumed raw outs_planning; these retained runs predate the occupancy-aware collision post-process fix.
driving_result_interpretation: PyTorch and all three TensorRT precisions follow similar initial motion and stall in repeated contact at about 2.1 to 2.4 percent dense-route progress. The shared failure reflects the raw-trajectory protocol, the offline nuScenes-to-CARLA sensor/domain mismatch, and the custom controller rather than a reduced-precision-only failure. Route and scenario catalogues exist in the reused V2Xverse tree, but this custom runner bypasses Leaderboard/ScenarioRunner and its scoring protocol; route progress, unique collision groups, lane invasions, and latency are diagnostic metrics only.
